parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent list of Alibaba Cloud regions.

parameters.name: RemoveSymbols
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to remove formatting symbols from the returned text. Valid values:

- true: Remove formatting symbols.
- false: Do not remove formatting symbols.

Default value: false.
